verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents warehouse destinations that receive event data with an automatically managed schema, names Snowflake explicitly, and builds Profiles/customer 360 inside the user's warehouse. The evidence never addresses user-controlled sync schedules or frequency, and BigQuery, ClickHouse and S3/lake landing are not named. Missing for 10: documented user-controlled load scheduling/sync frequency, explicit BigQuery/ClickHouse/S3 destination support, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, raw events and profiles land in my own warehouse or lake (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3) on a schedule I control

citations.quote: Now you can set up these warehouses as destinations in RudderStack and send all your event data from your preferred sources.
you don’t need to define a schema for your event data - RudderStack automatically does that for you by following a predefined warehouse schema
